main_topics.reason: User opened with A1C rising from 6.8 to 7.4 and wanted to understand why, driving the whole conversation.
User disclosed six months of broken sleep and loud snoring, returned to it at t21, and it became a main lead.
User asked what 'individualized' target meant after a doctor only said 'under 7', over a couple of turns.
User mentioned 5-6 pounds gained and asked if it matters for blood sugar; discussed briefly.
User said they have no meter, asked if they should get one and why fasting versus after-meal readings matter.
User wanted a plan to avoid 'the same shrug' and summarised an agenda to bring to the doctor.
User said they worried the diabetes was suddenly getting much worse and felt better after explanation.

output.summary: A 61-year-old user with a rising A1C (6.8 to 7.4) and no routine changes wanted to understand why. Through the conversation they identified poor sleep with heavy snoring and a small winter weight gain as likely contributors, and the bot explained individualized A1C targets and home monitoring. The user ended with a clear appointment agenda (two-week diary, ask about target, snoring and sleep study, meter) and said the conversation was far more useful than expected.
